title: Vaccine NFT
tagline: Vaccine NFT is a growth hack to promote COVID-19 vaccination using NFTs. Get a free NFT after your COVID-19 vaccination.
description: Vaccine NFT is a growth hack to promote COVID-19 vaccination using NFTs. Get a free NFT after your COVID-19 vaccination. It provides the best user experience by allowing users to sign-in using their social identifiers powered by Torus. An ethereum account is automatically created which is linked with the selected social identifier. Hence the NFTs can be easily sent to the ethereum account linked with the social identifier by using the Torus resolver to convert social identifier to an ethereum address. On login, the user is shown whether they own the COVID-19 vaccination NFT or not. If user does not own it, then they are encouraged to get vaccinated. It also allows the user to verify vaccination status for others by using their social identifiers or ethereum account. Vaccine NFT supports Skale Network, Matic Mumbai and Rinkeby testnet.
